mstts:express-as.prosody: As we wrap up, let's take a moment to really sit with what this journey has shown us. Living outside the lines isn't just a single act of bravery, is it? It's something you choose, every single day. The Argonauts reminds us of people who won't let other folks define them, who create family and home even when life feels uncertain, and who learn that love isn’t about squeezing into someone else’s shape—it's about making room for each other to grow. Here are a few gentle reminders to carry with you: Language? It's just a tool—it can’t possibly capture every truth you live. Family isn’t about following someone else’s script; it’s built through care, day by day. Your body is always changing, never a final answer or a fixed destiny. And while theory might point the way, life itself is always a little messier—and honestly, even more beautiful. Becoming yourself? That’s never finished. There’s no finish line—just the next step forward. If you ever find yourself searching for words, or for a sense of home, or just hoping to be seen—remember, you’re not on your own. The world won’t always make it easy, but there’s real power in the questions you ask and the life you build, moment by moment. Let yourself be changed by love, by uncertainty, by the simple act of showing up every day. Trust that your story matters, even if it doesn’t fit the usual patterns. And above all—know that courage isn’t about “arriving.” It’s about keeping on, together, with hope, honesty, and care. Here’s to the ongoing, beautiful work of becoming—one step at a time.
